content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to use Russian Cyrillic text on the [product_name] operator panel? Thank you for your response. [user_name]

Hello [user_name]! Based on the [document] for the [product_name] with [article_no], specifically chapter 5.2.3 on page 224, Russian language is supported. The [product_name] operator panel supports the same languages as the main module. Regards
Hello, Thank you for the response. I will verify this once I receive the new [article_no] with the operator panel. Thanks for your help. [user_name]
Yes, it is possible. I have managed to use both German and Russian languages in the same operator panel. The main challenge lies in configuring your computer to select the correct Russian characters.

Hi everyone, You can switch between German and Russian languages, likely using a flag such as M27 for this purpose. It's necessary to select two languages in the message block (for example, block B001 Message): Text 1: ISO-8859-1 coding for German, English, Italian, Spanish (partially), Dutch (partially). Text 2: ISO-8859-5 coding for Russian.
